reason: My renderer is gone and I do need someone reliable, and since it's billed on the pre-construction line the client pays, not me. No deposit and I only pay if I like the sample on my own plan, so there's little to lose by taking the lunch.
objection: My clients have never asked for this before the house is built, so I worry it's an extra I'm selling them. I also don't know if they'll actually open a link and use it, or if the plans come out accurate enough that I'm correcting finishes every round at $500.
would_change_my_mind: If the sample of my own plan came out wrong on layout or finishes, or I needed more than one revision to get it right, I'd walk.
